title: Decide who writes .tick/logs/herd manifests, or re-point the three readers left on a dead contract
body: tk herd spawn was the only writer of the .tick/logs/herd manifests and nkf deleted it; verified that internal/herd/state.Write now has no production caller (tests only). Three survivors still read the contract: internal/herd/dashboard/snapshot.go (os6 documented and accepted the 'zero workers' consequence), internal/herd/relay/identity.go recordedManifests (blocked-agent-to-tick identity resolution — undocumented), and cmd/tk/cmd/frontier.go ~245-251 (the live-worker overlay behind tk ready, which ticfac itself calls — undocumented). Either give ticfac a manifest writer for herdr-driven runs, re-point the readers at ticfac's run records, or record the relay and frontier degradation as deliberately as os6 did for the dashboard.
